ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the semicircular track is located above the horizontal ground, the left end point is labeled A, the center O is on the horizontal ground line, and point B is located on the upper right side of the semicircular arc; from the initial position of the small ball to B there is a dashed parabolic trajectory, indicating that the small ball is doing horizontal projectile motion; from O to B there is a dashed radius, and the figure marks that OB makes an angle of 60° with the horizontally rightward direction. Then reason: take O as the origin, the horizontally rightward direction as the x-axis, and the vertically upward direction as the y-axis. The radius of the semicircle is R, and A is the left end point, so the coordinates of A are (-R,0). The small ball is thrown horizontally from directly above A, and the initial velocity is v0. B is on the circular arc, and OB makes 60° with the horizontally rightward direction, so the coordinates of B are (Rcos60°, Rsin60°)=(R/2, √3R/2). The horizontal displacement from the throwing point to B is R/2-(-R)=3R/2, so the horizontal projectile time t=(3R/2)/v0=3R/(2v0). At point B the small ball is just tangent to the semicircular track, so the velocity direction of the small ball is along the tangent to the circle at B, and the tangent is perpendicular to OB. Since OB makes 60° with the horizontal, the tangent at point B along the direction of motion of the small ball makes an angle of -30° with the horizontal, so the velocity components satisfy vy/vx=-tan30°=-1/√3. In horizontal projectile motion, vx=v0, vy=-gt, so gt/v0=1/√3. Substituting t=3R/(2v0), we get g·3R/(2v0^2)=1/√3, and solving gives v0^2=3√3gR/2, therefore v0=√(3√3gR/2).

method.method_draft: 建立以 O 为原点、水平向右为 x 轴、竖直向上为 y 轴的坐标系。先从图中读出半圆轨道在水平面上方，A 是左端点，所以 A 坐标为 (-R,0)，小球从 A 正上方水平抛出；B 在圆弧上，且半径 OB 与水平向右方向成 60°，所以 B 坐标为 (R\cos60^\circ, R\sin60^\circ)=(R/2,\sqrt3 R/2)。从 A 正上方到 B 的水平位移为 R/2-(-R)=3R/2，因此平抛时间 t=(3R/2)/v_0。再利用“恰好相切”：小球到 B 点时速度方向必须沿圆的切线，而切线垂直于 OB。由于 OB 与水平成 60°，B 点切线沿小球运动方向与水平夹角为 -30°，故速度分量满足 v_y/v_x=-\tan30^\circ=-1/\sqrt3。平抛中 v_x=v_0，v_y=-gt，于是 gt/v_0=1/\sqrt3。联立 t=3R/(2v_0)，得 g\cdot 3R/(2v_0^2)=1/\sqrt3，解出 v_0=\sqrt{\frac{3\sqrt3 gR}{2}}。
